name: Plan & design
blurb: Shape the work before the code: interviews, specs, domain language, plans, API contracts and decision records.

name: Build
blurb: Write the change well: test-first loops, thin verifiable slices and simpler code.

name: Test & debug
blurb: Find the real cause, prove the fix with evidence, and test in a real browser.

name: Review
blurb: Review changes against your standards and the original intent, and take feedback with rigour.

name: Security
blurb: Threat models, hardening and the checks that matter before real users arrive.

name: Performance
blurb: Measure first, then fix what the trace actually shows.

name: Ship & operate
blurb: Git hygiene, guardrails, CI and launch readiness.

name: Cloud & infrastructure
blurb: Provision, secure and run infrastructure: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Terraform, containers and Kubernetes.

name: Databases & data
blurb: Schemas, queries, migrations and access rules for the databases you actually run.

name: Languages & frameworks
blurb: Current, idiomatic practice for a specific language or framework, from the people who maintain it.

name: Agent workflow
blurb: Context, delegation, and building your own skills and tools.
